name: ProSocial
description: ProSocial helps people build practical people skills through personalized coaching and practice. This read-only connector lets Claude retrieve the connected member’s current ProSocial People Skills Index profile, including seven trainable skill dimensions and a coaching delivery preference, after the member connects the account and enables profile sharing. It does not assess personality or allow Claude to modify the ProSocial account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ProSocial to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ProSocial to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.tryprosocial.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ProSocial MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ProSocial provides these MCP tools: get_my_people_skills_profile.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ProSocial?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to ProSocial in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
ProSocial requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ProSocial is developed by Science of People. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
